name: Meta Superintelligence Labs
headquarters: Menlo Park, CA, USA (with SF, NYC, Paris & London Pods)
founders: Mark Zuckerberg (Founder & CEO, Meta), Alexandr Wang (Chief AI Officer & Head of MSL), Nat Friedman (Head of PAR), Aparna Ramani (Head of MSL Infra)

financial_highlights.four_pillar_msl_architecture: 1. TBD Lab (~200-person elite core frontier pod) | 2. FAIR (V-JEPA, DINOv3, Science) | 3. Products & Applied Research (Nat Friedman) | 4. MSL Infra (Aparna Ramani)
financial_highlights.gigawatt_clusters: Prometheus (1GW+ Ohio Supercluster) & Hyperion (Multi-GW Louisiana Campus)

divisions: TBD Lab — Elite ~200-Person Core Frontier Model & Reasoning Pod (Alexandr Wang — Muse & Frontier Reasoning)
FAIR — Fundamental AI Research (V-JEPA Latent World Models, DINOv3, Embodied AI & Open Molecules/Materials)
Products & Applied Research — PAR (Nat Friedman — Ultra-Flat Pods, Meta AI, Standalone Muse Agents & Smart Glasses)
MSL Infra — Gigawatt Training & Inference Fabric (Aparna Ramani — Prometheus, Hyperion, PyTorch/Triton & MTIA)
Llama Open-Weight & Sovereign Enterprise Ecosystem (Llama Stack, TorchTune & Distillation Partnerships)
MSL Frontier Safety, Red-Teaming, Synthetic Data Quality & Autonomous Agent Safeguards
challenges: Protecting TBD Lab Small-Team Talent Density Inside a Megacap: Preserving zero-bureaucracy, researcher-per-GPU velocity inside TBD Lab (~200 researchers) while aligning across Meta's 3.3B+ daily Family-of-Apps ecosystem.

Prometheus & Hyperion Multi-Gigawatt Cluster Goodput: Mitigating Silent Data Corruption (SDC), optical fabric stragglers, and utility power-ramp transients across 200,000+ Blackwell/MTIA accelerators.

Frontier Proprietary Models (Muse) vs. Open-Weight Llama Strategy: Calibrating which frontier reasoning capabilities remain proprietary vs. released as open weights under ASL/catastrophic-risk thresholds.

Bridging FAIR V-JEPA World Models into Live Consumer & Ray-Ban/Orion Hardware: Deploying sub-200ms multimodal world perception and full-duplex voice agents onto thermally constrained wearable glasses.
Monetizing Autonomous Business & Creator Agents: Converting Meta AI and WhatsApp/Instagram business messaging agents into verifiable commercial ROAS without degrading user trust.
